alignment.accounting: sum of training, validation, diagnostics and failed/timeout worker durations; final test separately reported as in run2.sh
alignment.trial_limit_policy: cap 1.5 * 10800 seconds, prorate remaining shared budget before concurrent dispatch
alignment.llm_reference_difference: RecHarness native GLM orchestrator and Claude Code implementation transport both replaced with the identical Codex gpt-6.1-sol/medium transport used by the other three methods.
alignment.search_scope: six SASRec arms including joint hyperparameter tuning; distinct 2-4-direction jump batches; validation-only evidence memory
alignment.execution_isolation: trusted local processes; test directory omitted from training environment, not an OS filesystem jail

recharness.implementation: isolated native RecHarness jump-v4 multi-combination fork

jump_policy.scope: Amazon Reviews matched experiments; model family remains constrained by original prompts
jump_policy.global_budget_change: none; reservation and all failed attempts are charged within the existing cap
jump_policy.local_promotion: compare against current basin incumbent; preserve monotone global validation history
jump_policy.trial_cap: ceil(max(min_trial_seconds + 5, p75(last 32 positive measured trial costs) * 1.25 + 5))
jump_policy.retune_group_size: largest integer 1..4 fitting the chosen jump batch plus four retune groups
jump_policy.acceptance: retune best validation score strictly exceeds pre-jump global incumbent
jump_policy.incomplete_window: restore old incumbent unless already exceeded; no delayed alpha/beta credit
jump_policy.comparison: same data, evaluator, LLM and total GPU budget for jump on/off; exploration trigger is logged explicitly
jump_policy.jump_type: batch of up to four distinct combinations; each modifies 2-4 registered directions spanning at least two parent categories
jump_policy.normal_reward: strict validation improvement over the group-start basin incumbent
jump_policy.category_credit: pair reward only; no component credit
jump_policy.trial_batch: maximize up to four candidates, then retune width within the same protected envelope; only best valid jump enters one basin
jump_policy.hyperparameter_arm: hyperparameter_tuning: joint settings of existing program, no new mechanism
jump_policy.memory: per-candidate concrete proposal, source provenance, input-relative validation delta, execution cost and status; bounded relevant retrieval for hypothesis and implementation

baseline.origin: original RecHarness default SASRec cold start, without TPE parameter bindings
baseline.epochs_note: matched host sets SASREC_EPOCHS=200, overriding the standalone template default 300

recharness.transport: same gpt-6.1-sol/medium; three retries then cooldown at the same pending request; process-group cleanup
recharness.selection: native incumbent after safe jump finalization; validation only; final held-out test once
recharness.single_model: independent prediction fusion disallowed; audit is charged within each GPU trial

prior_protocol_charge.reason: Fresh default-cold-start SASRec search requested with 43200 GPU seconds; historical experiments archived separately

feature_construction.label: 特征构造
feature_construction.scope: Construct input features solely from supplied training interactions, such as frequency or recency indicators. No external metadata, independent scorer or score fusion. Keep learned embedding design, SASRec topology, readout, loss and optimizer fixed.

embedding_representation.label: 嵌入表征
embedding_representation.scope: Item embedding dimensions, parameterization, tying and embedding normalization. Keep feature definitions, interaction/scoring mechanism, SASRec topology, history policy, loss and optimizer fixed.

architecture_interaction.label: 架构与交互
architecture_interaction.scope: Coordinate SASRec attention blocks, feed-forward structure, residual paths and jointly trained interaction/scoring formulas such as bilinear compatibility. Keep the causal SASRec family, input features, embedding parameterization, sequence selection/readout, loss and optimizer fixed. No independent scorer fusion.

sequence_interest.label: 序列与兴趣
sequence_interest.scope: Coordinate causal history truncation, position representation and readout of encoder states, including recency or attention pooling. Keep input feature definitions, embedding parameterization, backbone topology, scoring formula, loss and optimizer fixed. Never introduce future interactions or change supplied splits.

learning_objective.label: 学习目标
learning_objective.scope: Ranking/prediction loss, loss weighting and jointly trained auxiliary objectives. Preserve feature definitions, embeddings, SASRec topology, scoring/readout, optimizer, sampling, scheduler and batch/epoch settings.

hyperparameter_tuning.label: 联合调参
hyperparameter_tuning.scope: Jointly tune multiple numeric/categorical hyperparameters of the existing program: embedding/hidden dimensions, attention block depth and heads, feed-forward width, max history length, learning rate, dropout, weight decay, batch size, optimizer choice and scheduler settings. A candidate may change any compatible subset together; explain their coupling. Keep the current feature definitions, embedding parameterization/tying, interaction formula, readout formula, loss definition and SASRec model family. Do not add new computational modules or change data splits, seed 42, epoch cap 200, batches per epoch 200 or GPU/CPU allocation.

arm_policy.regular_routing: one TS draw for each of six arms; select top four without replacement
arm_policy.gpu_budget_allocation: selection frequency allocates slots over rounds; equal per-candidate caps within a group; charge actual worker duration
arm_policy.regular_reward: Bernoulli success iff valid host validation strictly exceeds the group-start local incumbent
arm_policy.jump_routing: budget-safe batch of up to four unique combinations, each with 2-4 directions spanning at least two parents; only best valid candidate opens one retune window
arm_policy.jump_credit: one delayed combination_jump outcome counter; no unidentifiable component-direction credit and no separate prior for each pair
arm_policy.edit_contract: exact selected direction set, per-direction nontrivial AST edits, logged rationale; semantic scope prompt-enforced

base_model.origin: original RecHarness default SASRec cold start, without TPE parameter bindings
base_model.epochs_note: matched host sets SASREC_EPOCHS=200, overriding the standalone template default 300

memory_policy.archive: per-run immutable observations, programs, lifecycle events and request contexts
